title: Keater Miller's Store, Main Street, burned Aug 7, 1956
description: In January 1945, Gordon R. Miller purchased the Days Inn from Gurston Day for $6,000 upon Day’s retirement. Day had operated a hotel, dining room, and fruit and ice cream shop just north of the Bank of Montreal. Miller previously spent 15 years working at V.W. Simm’s store on Main Street. In January 1946, Miller remodelled his new store by installing new windows. On August 9, 1956, a major fire broke out at Keater’s Lunch Bar, with firefighters from Woodstock, Bristol, East Florenceville, and the NB Forest Service joining local crews in an attempt to save the downtown block. The building was not rebuilt after the fire.
